petTip: Click: summarize this document; double-click: batch summarize a notebook
promptHint: Each style can have its own prompt: a custom prompt is sent as-is; when empty, the built-in rule applies (the default prompt plus the style requirement shown as placeholder).
summarizingLong: The document is long; summarizing a truncated copy…
alreadySummarized: This document already has an AI summary; skipped
resummarize: Ignore the existing summary and summarize again
previewHint: The heading and a trailing divider are added automatically. Closing this window discards the summary. Pressing Enter writes to the default position (configurable in settings).
copyFailed: Copy failed; select the text and copy manually
doneAppend: Appended to the end of the document
deleteSummaryConfirm: This removes %s blocks of the AI summary (the heading and the blocks up to the divider). Continue?
deleteSummaryNoEnd: Could not find the divider that ends the summary; cancelled to avoid deleting content. Please remove it manually.
done: Inserted at the top of the document
aiFailed: AI request failed (make sure AI is configured in SiYuan settings)
summaryAction: Read the following document and write a concise summary in the document's main language. Use short bullet points when helpful. Output only the summary itself, without repeating the original text or adding extra explanation. Mark key words or sentences as ==highlighted text== (1-3 per paragraph or bullet, never highlight a whole paragraph, and do not nest other marks).
overviewAction: Below are the per-document summaries of one notebook. In the documents' main language, write one overall overview: first the shared theme, then the key conclusions or points. Output only the overview text, do not repeat each document, and add no extra explanation. Mark key words or sentences as ==highlighted text== (1-3 per paragraph).
batchOptAppend: Insert each summary at the top of its own document
batchOptOverview: Add an overall overview at the top
batchCreateFailed: Could not create the summary document: %s
tagPrompt: Extract 3 to 5 keywords that best describe the document below, to be used as note tags. Output only the keywords separated by English commas, without # signs, numbering or explanation.
styleOneLinePrompt: Read the following document and write a one-sentence summary in the document's main language: one short sentence that captures the single most important conclusion or point. Output only that sentence: no title, no explanation, do not repeat the original text; when helpful, mark one key phrase as ==…==.
styleBulletsPrompt: Read the following document and list 3-6 key points in the document's main language, one per line, each starting with "- "; each line covers a single point, keeps the key facts and conclusions, and avoids vague wording. Output only the list itself: no title, no intro or closing line; you may mark the key phrases in each line with ==…== (1-2 per line).
styleDetailedPrompt: Read the following document and write a detailed summary of 150-250 words in the document's main language, in 2-3 paragraphs: first the topic and background, then the main arguments, evidence and conclusions, keeping the document's logical order. Output only the summary text: no title, no extra explanation, do not paraphrase sentence by sentence; you may mark key words or sentences with ==…== (1-3 per paragraph, never highlight a whole paragraph).
styleQuotesPrompt: Pick 3-5 of the most representative verbatim sentences from the document below, preferring sentences that state the main point, express a clear opinion, or are especially well written. Requirements: keep the original wording unchanged; one sentence per line, each starting with "- "; do not use ==…== highlights. Output only the list of quotes: no title, no explanation, and do not add anything of your own.
styleActionsPrompt: Read the following document and turn its ideas or methods into 3-5 actionable suggestions in the document's main language: one per line, each starting with "- "; each suggestion covers a single action and is written concretely and practically, avoiding empty slogans. Output only the list itself: no title, no explanation; when helpful, you may mark one key action in each line with ==…==.
titleImgFailed: Could not set the title image: %s
titleImgFallback: Title image added (built-in cover unavailable, used the plugin's own image)
coverPrompt: Choose the cover category that best fits the document below. Available categories: %s. Output only one category id, with no explanation.
